feature: US date order, PR 1 (player dates): every fixed-width or tight slot that draws a player date, at its longest realistic value
note: Run on a scratch branch made from local-dev. DATE_DECK (the audit account's HD - Tovolar) had v1 committed_at set to 2025-12-31 18:00 UTC and its two games played_at 2025-12-31 18:00 and 2026-09-30 18:00 UTC; DATE_DECK_2 (HD - Avatar Aang) had v1 2025-12-31 and v2 2026-09-30. So the slots draw Dec 31, 2025 (the longest year-carrying form) and Sep 30 (the longest short form).
